card.name: Words just before US agency or law names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of' or an opening parenthesis right before a named US government body, law or organization, mostly in education and disability-access or federal-government text.

modes.label: Before a named law or agency
modes.description: The word 'the' or '(' comes right before the name or acronym of a federal law or agency.

modes.label: Before an organization or resource name
modes.description: A verb or 'of' or 'is' comes right before a named group or resource in disability-access or political text.
modes.example: - For Audio Format, we<< recommend>> Learning Ally.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are unrelated and mixed.
